headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 30, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a crucial 8-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Didier Fuentes earning the win. JJ Bleday led the Braves' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The San Diego Padres also secured a win, defeating the Washington Nationals 7-5 behind Curtis Mead's 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, with Andrew Nardi of the Miami Marlins being placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left rib cage stress reaction. The Chicago White Sox have also been affected, with Munetaka Murakami and Jordan Leasure both dealing with injuries. The Los Angeles Dodgers have transferred Blake Snell to the 60-day injured list and placed Teoscar Hernández on the 10-day injured list.

The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Miami Marlins have also made a trade, acquiring RF Rece Hinds from the Cincinnati Reds in exchange for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Braves Take Down Reds 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured an 8-3 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Didier Fuentes earning the win. JJ Bleday led the Braves' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Nationals 7-5**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 7-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Minnesota Twins 6-5 in a closely contested matchup. Trevor Larnach led the Twins with 2 hits, including a home run, while Wilber Dotel pitched 3 scoreless innings for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Orioles in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mason Fluharty earning the win and Braydon Fisher securing the save.

top_news.title: **Marlins Pitcher Nardi Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins left-handed pitcher Andrew Nardi has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left rib cage stress reaction, effective retroactive to May 28, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez.
